source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
When this model is **destroyed** for the first time in any battle round, roll a D6 when that phase ends. On a 2+, return it to the battlefield:

- with 3 wounds left
- as near as it can be to the spot where it died
- outside **Engagement Range** of all enemy units

It can return this way only once per battle.

trigger.occurrence: first time in a battle round

setBackUp.placement: as close as possible to where destroyed, not within Engagement Range of enemy units
